question: Lata Mangeshkar was awarded by the India's highest civilian honour 'Bharat Ratna' in the year ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2001**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** was awarded India's highest civilian honour, the **'Bharat Ratna'**, in the year **2001**.
 
• The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award in India, given for exceptional service towards the advancement of art, literature, science, and in recognition of public service of the highest order.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar, often referred to as the 'Nightingale of India', is one of the most respected playback singers in India.
 
• Her contribution to Indian music spans over seven decades, and she has sung in more than 1,000 Hindi films and many regional languages.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Bharat Ratna** was instituted in the year **1954**.
 
• The award does not carry any monetary grant but a certificate (Sanad) signed by the President and a medallion.
 
• There is no formal provision that recipients of the Bharat Ratna should be Indian citizens.
 
• The first recipients of the Bharat Ratna were C. Rajagopalachari, Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan, and C.V. Raman.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar is one of the few playback singers to have received this prestigious award, highlighting her monumental contributions to Indian music.
